title: Naga administrator is new LTO chief; Lacanilao to head Marina
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has appointed Naga City Administrator Noreen Bernadette San Luis as the new head of the Land Transportation Office (LTO), Malacañang said Tuesday.
